headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices logged notable losses amid foreign investor selling and global economic concerns.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Foreign institutional investors executed heavy selling, wiping out significant market capitalization.
Concerns over crude oil prices and global rate hikes triggered capital outflows from emerging markets.
Benchmark indices completed eight consecutive weeks of losses, marking a major multi-year decline.
Trading remained suspended following the Gandhi Jayanti holiday on October 2 leading into the weekend.
whatHappening: SEBI announced it will soon issue a framework on the Closing Auction Session after reviewing over 3,500 comments.
RBI Governor noted that current financial resilience in the system does not guarantee long-term stability.
Cube Highways Trust successfully raised Rs 1,150 crore through AAA-rated non-convertible debentures.
Analysts are sharing strategies for key IT and fintech stocks ahead of the upcoming Q2 earnings season.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend after remaining closed on October 2 for Gandhi Jayanti. In preceding trading sessions, the market faced selling pressure led by foreign capital outflows and global headwinds. Market participants are watching key technical support levels and awaiting upcoming Q2 corporate earnings.
